strongest_route_when: The buyer has a repeated manual workflow, can name the handoff pain, and the builder can show a before-after workflow
weak_route_when: The buyer only wants vague AI adoption advice or private account takeover is required
recommended_first_asset: Workflow screenshot, scope page, intake checklist, and setup boundary
evidence_needed_before_payment: Qualified reply or paid pilot request plus safe access boundary

strongest_route_when: The topic has source-backed search intent, original tools or templates, and a maintainable update owner
weak_route_when: Pages would repeat public advice, copy competitors, or rely only on third-party volume estimates
recommended_first_asset: Guide hub, source register, quality gate, and small route batch
evidence_needed_before_payment: GSC or Bing export, source-backed SERP review, or sample user action

strongest_route_when: The user repeats a measurable task, manual proof exists, and support capacity is realistic
weak_route_when: The task is rare, data rights are unclear, or maintenance cost exceeds expected price
recommended_first_asset: Free checker, sample output, event list, and upgrade boundary
evidence_needed_before_payment: Tool completion evidence, repeated requests, or confirmed setup budget

strongest_route_when: The buyer repeats a narrow task and the pack includes domain constraints, examples, and rejection rules
weak_route_when: Generic AI can create equivalent output from the same inputs
recommended_first_asset: Preview page, before-after examples, refund boundary, and usage limits
evidence_needed_before_payment: Sample usage, buyer reply, or low-risk payment test

strongest_route_when: Owned or permitted data exists, entities have unique value, and supply can be seeded manually
weak_route_when: Data is copied, stale, undifferentiated, or either marketplace side cannot be sourced manually
recommended_first_asset: Entity model, noindex rules, trust boundary, and manual seed list
evidence_needed_before_payment: Data-rights evidence plus buyer or supplier request proof

strongest_route_when: The buyer already has an offer and needs build/setup work more than a plan
weak_route_when: The buyer wants broad strategy, guaranteed traffic, or an undefined product
recommended_first_asset: Before-after sample, revision limit, delivery checklist, and handoff plan
evidence_needed_before_payment: Confirmed implementation need plus capacity and scope boundary
